_comment: Blood and torn limbs (scripts/fx/gore.gd). materials.<material from data/enemies>: what a body of that stuff bleeds; bodies.<elian | enemy id>: keys laid over its material's. Keys: blood #rrggbb(aa) — the colour; shade — how far each drop and mark strays darker or lighter from it (0..0.5); drops — drops a blow throws (more for a crit, a backstab, a heavy blow); spray — how fast they fly, px/s; stain — how big the marks they leave are (0 = they leave none); stain_life — seconds a mark stays before it fades; gush — drops a death throws; pool — how wide the pool under a body grows, px (0 = none); bleed — seconds a wound keeps dripping; spurt — seconds a stump jets in pulses after a tear (0 = it only drips); limbs — pieces the body tears into on death, cut from its own drawing (0 = it never does; 2 upper/lower, 3 head/torso/legs, 4 + two legs, 5–6 + arms); chance — how often a death tears it apart (a crit or a backstab doubles it); fling — how hard the pieces fly, px/s; cuts — how a tear goes, by weight: all (to pieces), head (the head off), half (at the waist), limb (an arm off; a body of 4 or fewer pieces has none and loses its head) — what is left stands a beat, then topples. Cut lines are ragged, every death different. Where it lands: mist — faint specks a blow throws that leave no mark; soak — how much of a mark sinks into the painting under it rather than lying on top (0..1, a multiply pass); splash — droplets a heavy drop throws back up off a floor; run — px a streak runs down a wall (never past the wall's foot; less of it on the painting behind); drip — how readily what reaches over a ledge's edge or sticks under it drips off (0..1); back — the share of drops that fly into the depth and stick to the painted wall behind (never in the sky or a far opening). cloud — px a drop spreads into a faint cloud when it falls in water (the room's water zones; 0 = it just sinks); hiss — how often a drop on lava goes up as steam (0..1). Reduced blood throws no mist and no splashes. A mark stops at the edge of what it lies on. moves.<attack | attack2 | attack3 | rising | thrust | dash_strike | lunge | cleave | sweep | slam | dash | blink | nova | bolt | drain | toll | hex | burst>: how the blow that opened the body changes it (Gore.MOVE_DEFAULTS for the rest) — aim (degrees the spray turns from the blow's line, negative up), spread, force, drops (× the fan, speed, count), height (px the wound sits above the middle, negative lower), fling, lift (× how hard the pieces fly and how much upward), scatter (share flung back the other way), chance (× the tear's chance), pool (× the pool), jet (how often the spray is one jet), cuts (the ways this blow tears, instead of the body's). Settings → Blood: full, reduced (half the drops, no limbs), off. Edited in the art studio, tab «Кровь».
